Prioridade de socorro

The highest level of urgency assigned to radio or communication messages involving imminent danger and the need for immediate assistance.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Prioridade de socorro?

In this glossary, Prioridade de socorro refers to: The highest level of urgency assigned to radio or communication messages involving imminent danger and the need for immediate assistance.

How is Prioridade de socorro used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Todas as estações, o Canal 16 VHF está reservado para prioridade de socorro; limite as comunicações apenas a emergências e tráfego de socorro."

Why does Prioridade de socorro matter in maritime?

Prioridade de socorro matters because it supports clear communication in Emergency Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Prioridade de socorro?

Prioridade de socorro is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Prioridade de socorro belong to?

In this glossary, Prioridade de socorro is grouped under Emergency Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

The highest level of urgency assigned to radio or communication messages involving imminent danger and the need for immediate assistance.

Operational example

All stations, VHF Channel 16 is reserved for distress priority; limit communications to emergencies and distress traffic only.

Localized term

Prioridade de socorro

Localized example

Todas as estações, o Canal 16 VHF está reservado para prioridade de socorro; limite as comunicações apenas a emergências e tráfego de socorro.
